manual_scope: The /t/ release segmentation is the newly manually segmented layer qualifying for core. Source-faithful mirroring preserves the mixed p/t/k table, but p/k rows are not promoted until their manual/lineage status is reconciled against Puggaard 2021.
lineage_rule: Do not count the underlying 1970s recordings as a new primary corpus. Inclusion is based on the separately isolatable new manual phonetic annotation/measurement layer. Reused p/k VOT measurements must be deduplicated at recording/token lineage level.
